# KiCad 10.0.6 via payload

Captured through GetItems from a disposable, native pcbnew-generated two-net board on Windows using KiCad 10.0.6. The via was created at (20,25) mm, GND, 0.3 mm drill, 0.6 mm diameter. This fixture contains no customer data. The parent KIID is KiCad's native field 7. Reproduce with the ignored via_lifecycle_live_test against an isolated scratch board.
